scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix ../frontend ci && npm --prefix ../frontend run check && npm --prefix ../frontend run build
scripts.test:agent: uv run --project agent --locked python -m unittest discover -s agent/tests
scripts.synth: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:agent && cdk synth
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:agent && cdk bootstrap && cdk deploy
